title: Further Regarding The Shooting And Wounding Of A Male German Refugee And A Male Chinese By A Japanese Sentry On The Hongkew Bridge

page_data.en:
S.L. (Special Branch)
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SP. BR. REGISTRY
407
6 10/ 40

" C "
Misc. 548/40.        Hongkew
                     October 5th,      40.

Further regarding the shooting and wounding
of a male German neutral and a male Chinese
by a Japanese sentry on the Hongkew Bridge.

An inquest presided over by Procurator Tsang Tsoong
Zu, was held at the Public Mortuary on the A.M. of
1-10-40, over the body of deceased Heinrich Schlesinger.
Verdict:-    Death due to injuries received from
             gunshot. Body to be removed by the
             International Jewish Committee for
             burial.

It is also learnt from the Naval Landing Party
that the chauffeur Au Pan Yoong, died on the day he
was shot, 30-9-40.

（签名）
Sen. Det 1/c.

D. S. 326.
（手写批注：C.O.S Rel）

杂项 548/40。        虹口
                     1940年10月5日，      40。

续报关于一名德国中立国男性及一名中国男性在虹口桥被日本哨兵枪击受伤一事。

由检察官臧松祖（Tsang Tsoong Zu，音译）主持的验尸审讯于1940年10月1日上午在公立殓房举行，针对死者海因里希·施莱辛格（Heinrich Schlesinger）的尸体进行。
裁决：-    死因为枪伤所致。尸体将由国际犹太委员会移走安葬。

另从海军陆战队获悉，司机欧潘荣（Au Pan Yoong，音译）于中枪当日，即1940年9月30日死亡。

（签名）
高级警探 1/c。

D. S. 326.
（手写批注：C.O.S Rel）
（手写批注：II D.B. Pk）

REGISTRY
407
"C"
Misc.No. 548/40.
Hongkew
October 1st, 40
2
Further regarding The shooting and wounding
of a male German Refugee and a male Chinese
by a Japanese sentry on the Hongkew Bridge.
At 11.25 a.m. on 1/10/40, information was
received from Wayside Station to the effect that the
injured man Heinrich Schlesinger, had died.
Enquiries at the Shanghai Sanitarium Clinic,
revealed that the patient had expired at 3 a.m. even
date, certificate issued stating "Heinrich Schlesinger,
died at this hospital 3 a.m. today from gun shot wound
of abdomen.
The rifle bullet responsible, which was badly
bent and broken in two pieces was handed over to the
Police.
The body has been removed to the Public Mortuary
pending inquest being held on the a.m. of 2/10/40.
The Immigrants Committee have been notified
by the hospital of the death, whilst effort will be made
to have as many witnesses as possible attend the inquest.
S.M. Date 1/10.
D.S. SSS.
INDEXED BY
(S.S.) REGISTRY
DATE 2/10/40
D.D.O. "C".

杂项编号 548/40。
虹口
1940年10月1日
2
续报关于一名德国难民男性及一名中国男性在虹口桥被日本哨兵枪击受伤一事。
1940年10月1日上午11时25分，收到路边巡捕房来电，称伤者海因里希·施莱辛格已死亡。
经向上海疗养院诊所查询，得知该病人于当日凌晨3时去世，出具的证明书写明：“海因里希·施莱辛格，于今日凌晨3时在本医院因腹部枪伤去世。”
致伤的步枪子弹严重弯曲并断成两截，已移交警方。
尸体已被移至公立殓房，待1940年10月2日上午举行验尸审讯。
医院已通知移民委员会其死亡消息，同时将尽力安排尽可能多的证人出席验尸审讯。
S.M. 日期 10月1日。
D.S. SSS.
索引编制者
(S.S.) 登记室

M^r Ble Yorke
S.B. (Special Branch) copy

407
3 10 20

"C"
Misc. 548/40. Hongkong
September 30th 40.

1.

Re the shooting and wound of a male German Refugee
and a male Chinese by a Japanese sentry on the
Hongkew Bridge.

At 4.15 p.m. on 30/9/40, a telephone communication
was received from Wayside Station to the effect that a
German refugee who had been shot whilst travelling in an
omnibus on Broadway near Yuanchang Road, was lying
seriously injured in the Ward Road Refugee Hospital.
The undersigned accompanied by D.S. Tsuji, D.P.S. Isobe
and C.D.C. 234, conducted investigations proceeding to
the scene of the shooting as described by Wayside, but
failed to find any person who had knowledge of the occur-
rence, therefore the party proceeded to the Central China
Omnibus Company Office, Kungping Road, where information
was gained to the effect that the Company's bus No.195,
operating on Route No.6, had been damaged by gun fire,
but had been detailed to continue operating after having
reported to the office, however, arrangements were made
whereby the vehicle together with its driver and con-
ductress should be sent to Hungkew Station upon reporting
to the office on the return journey.

Enquiries were then carried to Wayside Station
where D.P.S. Meyers, was seen and stated that the injured
man one Heinrich Schlesinger, age 56 years, unemployed,
residing No.150 Haiphong Road, had been removed from
page_data.zh:
Ble Yorke 先生
特科（Special Branch）副本

407
3 10 20

"C"
杂项 548/40。 虹口
1940年9月30日。

1.

关于一名德国难民男性及一名中国男性在虹口桥被日本哨兵枪击受伤一事。

1940年9月30日下午4时15分，收到路边巡捕房电话通报，称一名德国难民在靠近元昌路（Yuanchang Road，音译）的百老汇路乘坐公共汽车时被枪击，现重伤躺在华德路难民医院。
具结人会同警探辻（Tsuji，音译）、副巡官矶部（Isobe，音译）及华捕第234号前往路边巡捕房所述之枪击现场进行调查，但未能找到任何知情者，因此一行人前往公平路华中公共汽车公司办事处，获知该公司6路线的第195号公共汽车曾遭枪击损坏，但在向办事处报告后被指派继续运营；不过，已作出安排，令该车辆连同其司机和女售票员在返程向办事处报到后，送往虹口巡捕房。

随后调查工作转至路边巡捕房，会见副巡官迈耶斯（Meyers），其陈述称伤者名为海因里希·施莱辛格，56岁，无业，居住在海防路150号，已从

page_data.en:
1/2

the Emigrants Hospital, No.138 Ward Road and handed the
undersigned a certificate which reads as follows:-
"Mr. Heinrich Schlesinger, 159 Muirhead Road, was
admitted to our hospital today about 4 p.m., suffering
from a bullet wound in his left hip, in serious condition.
We had the patient transferred to the Shanghai Sanitarium
Clinic, 171 Range Road, for operation.
Signed Dr. Veros, Superintendant, Emigrants
Hospital."
Returning to Hongkew Station it was found that
the bus concerned in the incident was standing outside,
examination of the vehicle revealed a hole about 3/4" x
1/4" in the tin body of its rear near side, this hole
which was about 14" below the window was found to have
continued through the wooden back of the seat inside,
which was in line with point of penetration, and emerged
out of the seat stuffing at such height that the bullet
responsible would enter the hip of any person sitting
on the rear seat facing the front of the vehicle.
Also found at the Station were two officers of
the Japanese Naval Landing Party and Mr.K.Yasuda, Chief
Inspector of the Central China Omnibus Company.
It was also learnt that at 4.30 p.m. one Wang
Fah Ling (芳林), M/truck owner, residing No.7,Lane No.
342 East Seward Road, had called at the Station to report
page_data.zh:
1/2

华德路138号移民医院转出，并向具结人递交了一份证明书，内容如下：
“海因里希·施莱辛格先生，居住缪尔黑德路（Muirhead Road，音译）159号，于今日下午4时许送入我院，左髋部受枪伤，情况危急。我院已将病人转至兰路（Range Road，音译）171号上海疗养院诊所进行手术。
签名：维罗斯（Veros，音译）医生，移民医院主管。”
返回虹口巡捕房后，发现涉案公共汽车停在外面，检查车辆发现其后部右侧铁皮车身有一个约3/4英寸 x 1/4英寸的孔洞，该孔洞位于车窗下方约14英寸处，经查发现该孔洞贯穿了内部座椅的木质靠背，与穿透点成一直线，并从座椅填充物中穿出，高度恰好使致伤子弹能击中任何面向车头坐在后排座位上的人的髋部。
在巡捕房还见到了两名日本海军陆战队军官以及华中公共汽车公司总稽查安田（K.Yasuda）先生。
另获悉，下午4时30分，卡车车主王芳林（Wang Fah Ling），居住东熙华德路342弄7号，曾到巡捕房报案，

page_data.en:
1/3

that his truck S.M.C.Lic.No.17300, had been detained by
the Japanese marines at the Hongkew Bridge, and the
driver of the truck one Ali Pal Yoong (夏保榮), arrested,
after having been shot. He had not witnessed anything
himself, but stated that the truck coolies had seen the
whole affair, he was therefore instructed to bring the
said coolies to the Station and later returned accom-
panied by three coolies namely:- Pien Yung Foh (片福),
residing No.8, Lane No.514 Haining Road; Ma Tsung Hio
(馬孝有), residing 7 Kwaping Road and Yin Ta (印大),
residing No.35 Zung Woo Li, North Kiangse Road, from
the statements of these three persons, together with
those of the driver of bus No.193 Kong Chien Chuen (江錢全)
and the conductress Yu Lien Ching (虞蓮卿) and information
submitted by the Naval Landing Party officers, the
following is a reconstruction of the occurrence as far
as can be ascertained :- During the afternoon of this
date M/truck No.17300, whilst being driven east to west
over the Hongkew Bridge, was for some reason called upon
to stop by a Japanese sentry, but the driver failed to
obey, whereupon the sentry concerned took the truck
number. Some time later (probably 5 p.m.), the truck
was seen to be returning along Broadway from West to East
and upon arrival at the bridge was halted and the driver
page_data.zh:
1/3

称其卡车（工部局执照号17300）在虹口桥被日本海军陆战队扣留，卡车司机阿里·帕尔·荣（Ali Pal Yoong，音译，中文名夏保榮）在中枪后被捕。他本人未目睹任何情况，但称卡车苦力看到了整个事件，因此被指示带上述苦力到巡捕房，随后他带着三名苦力返回，分别是：片福（Pien Yung Foh，音译），居住海宁路514弄8号；马孝有（Ma Tsung Hio，音译），居住瓜平路（Kwaping Road，音译）7号；印大（Yin Ta，音译），居住江西路北宗吾里（Zung Woo Li，音译）35号。根据这三人的陈述，以及193路公共汽车司机江钱全（Kong Chien Chuen，音译）和售票员虞莲卿（Yu Lien Ching，音译）的陈述，并结合海军陆战队军官提交的信息，尽可能查明的案发经过重构如下：- 当日下午，机动车第17300号卡车在由东向西行驶过虹口桥时，因某种原因被一名日本哨兵叫停，但司机未予服从，于是该哨兵记下了卡车号码。一段时间后（可能是下午5点），有人看到该卡车沿百老汇路由西向东返回，到达桥头时被拦下，司机

page_data.en:
1/4

An Pau Yoong, ordered to hand over his permit, he,
however, did not comply and jumping from the cab of his
vehicle attempted to run away, with the result that the
sentry fired a shot at him which took effect passing
through his body and at its reduced speed upon emerging,
struck and passed through the body work of the omnibus
which happened to be passing over the bridge at the time,
resulting in Mr. Schlesinger, being injured.

Following the shooting Mr. Schlesinger was taken
to the Immigrants Hospital in a public ricksha by his
friend Mr. C. Levi, German refugee, residing No.3, Lane
No.125 Wayside Road, this person later being escorted
to Hongkew Station by D. P. S. Meyer.

Enquiries at the Shanghai Sanitarium Clinic,
disclosed that Mr. Schlesinger had undergone an operation
during which the bullet had been removed, but nothing
could be ascertained regarding his condition owing to
Doctor Moore, who operated having left.

Sgn. Det. I/C.

D. D. O. "C".

D. S. Sd.
page_data.zh:
1/4

安保荣（An Pau Yoong，音译）被命令交出通行证，但他并未照办，而是从驾驶室跳下试图逃跑，结果哨兵向他开了一枪，子弹穿过其身体，速度减缓后穿出，击中了当时正巧过桥的一辆公共汽车的车身并穿透，导致施莱辛格先生受伤。

枪击发生后，施莱辛格先生由其朋友、德国难民C. Levi先生（居住威司克路（Wayside Road，音译）125弄3号）用一辆公共人力车送往移民医院，此人后来由副巡官迈耶斯护送至虹口巡捕房。

经向上海疗养院诊所查询，得知施莱辛格先生已接受手术，期间取出了子弹，但由于主刀的摩尔（Moore）医生已离开，无法获悉其病情状况。

签名。警探 I/C。

副助理总监 “C”。

D. S. 签名。

page_data.en:
Pien Vung Roh.
Kempo
C. D. C. 284
Hongkew
30/9/40
translated by Clerk Chao.

My name is Pien Vung Roh, age 29, Kempo, M/truck
coolie, residing at House No.8, Lane 514 Haining Road.
At about 3 p.m. on 30/9/40, I together with several
other coolies, were riding on motor truck S.M.C.Li e.No.17200,
travelling west to east along Broadway. However, when our
vehicle arrived at the Hongkew Bridge, it was stopped by a
Japanese Marine, who approached our driver and took from him
his driving permit, after which he ordered him to drive the
truck over the east side of the bridge and place it at the
roadside. This order having been obeyed the driver returned
to the bridge to request the return of his permit, but upon
arrival was detained by the Japanese who placed him in his
sentry box. Sometime later I heard the sound of an explosion
in the direction of the bridge, but as an omnibus was crossing
over at the time my view was obstructed, therefore I was
unaware that anything out of the ordinary had occurred until
a short time following the explosion a Japanese truck on which
two Marines were standing arrived at the bridge and our driver
who had blood on the clothing covering the lower part of body
was lifted into it and taken away.

Signed & crossmarked:- Pien Vung Roh.
page_data.zh:
片福（Pien Vung Roh，音译）。
广东人
华捕第284号
虹口
1940年9月30日
由赵书记员翻译。

我叫片福，29岁，广东人，卡车苦力，居住海宁路514弄8号。
1940年9月30日下午3点左右，我和其他几名苦力一起乘坐牌照号为S.M.C.Lic.No.17200（原文如此，前文为17300）的卡车，沿百老汇路由西向东行驶。然而，当我们的车辆到达虹口桥时，被一名日本海军陆战队员拦下，他走近我们的司机，拿走了他的驾驶执照，然后命令他将卡车开到桥的东侧并停在路边。司机 obeyed 这一命令后，回到桥头要求归还执照，但到达后被日本人扣留，并被关进他们的哨亭。过了一会儿，我听到桥方向传来一声爆炸声，但由于当时有一辆公共汽车正在过桥，挡住了我的视线，因此在爆炸后短时间内，直到一辆载有两名海军陆战队员的日本卡车到达桥头，并将我们那位下半身衣物沾满血的司机抬上车带走之前，我并不知道发生了任何异常事情。

签名并画押：- 片福。

page_data.en:
Hi Lien Ching
Ningpo
Hongkew 30/9/40 translated by Clerk Chan.

At about 3.50 p.m. on 30/9/40, whilst following my
occupation on bus No.193 of the Central China Omnibus Company,
travelling on Route No.6, on Broadway near the Hongkew Bridge,
I had the sound of an explosion and immediately the driver of
the bus called to me enquiring whether or not one of the
vehicle tyres had burst. As there was no alteration in the
smooth running of the bus, I replied that I did not think so,
whereupon he continued to drive forwards.

A few seconds later, however, I heard someone groaning
in pain at the rear of the bus and upon investigating saw a
male foreign passenger seated on the back seat with his hands
pressed against his left side and appearing to be in great
agony. I immediately called upon the driver to stop the bus,
and upon the vehicle being brought to a standstill the said
foreigner was assisted to the roadway by two other foreign
passengers.

I also alighted and observed a hole which appeared to
have been made by gun shot at rear near side of the bus, I
drew the driver's attention to this discovery and he walked
to Hongkew Bridge which lay about 150 yards West of the place
that we had stopped with the intent of reporting the matter
to the Japanese Marines usually on duty there, but upon
arrival at the bridge he was unable to find a Marine, so we
boarded the bus and drove to the Kungping Road office where
we reported to our Japanese superiors.

Signed & crossmarked:- Hi Lien Ching.
page_data.zh:
虞莲卿（Hi Lien Ching，音译）
宁波人
虹口 1940年9月30日 由陈书记员翻译。

1940年9月30日下午3点50分左右，当我在华中公共汽车公司6路线的第193号公共汽车上履行职责，行驶至虹口桥附近的百老汇路时，我听到一声爆炸声，随即公共汽车司机问我是否有一个轮胎爆了。由于公共汽车运行平稳，没有任何变化，我回答说不认为如此，于是他继续向前驾驶。

然而，几秒钟后，我听到公共汽车后部有人痛苦地呻吟，上前查看后发现一名外籍男乘客坐在后排座位上，双手按住左侧，显得非常痛苦。我立即叫司机停车，车辆停稳后，该名外籍人士在其他两名外籍乘客的协助下到路面上。

我也下了车，观察到公共汽车后部右侧有一个看似由枪击造成的孔洞，我提请司机注意这一发现，他步行前往位于我们停车地点以西约150码处的虹口桥，打算向通常在那里执勤的日本海军陆战队员报告此事，但到达桥头后未能找到海军陆战队员，于是我们登上公共汽车，驶往公平路办事处，向我们的日本上级报告。

签名并画押：- 虞莲卿。

page_data.en:
1) Name Ma Zeng Nie, age 45, native of Kompo, S/truck
coolie in the employ of Wong Ying Lee" Truck Co.
and residing at House No.7 Kunping Road.
2) Name Plan Toh, age 35, native of Kompo, M/truck
coolie and residing at No.35 Lun ; Noc Li, off North
Kiangse Road.

Statements identical to that made by Plan Aing Toh.
page_data.zh:
1) 姓名马增涅（Ma Zeng Nie，音译），45岁，广东籍，受雇于“王英利”（Wong Ying Lee，音译）卡车公司的卡车苦力，居住瓜平路7号。
2) 姓名Plan Toh（音译），35岁，广东籍，卡车苦力，居住江西路北伦诺克里（Lun ; Noc Li，原文不清/音译）35号。

陈述内容与 Plan Aing Toh（音译）所作陈述相同。
